title: Failed skill checks (e.g. Quartermaster Bray's tally-error check, Preceptor Aldous's 'press him' check) can simply be retried immediately with no in-fiction consequence beyond spending another turn, which removes most tension from a stated 'DC' system — a bad roll is never actually a setback, just a delay.
where: The Quartermaster's Wagon (Camp Gallows) / 'find the error in his tally'
